name: @qingshanjiluo/dsh-plugin-suite
description: One-click install/configure/uninstall CLI for the whole @qingshanjiluo/dsh-* plugin collection against a DeepSeek Harness profile

scripts.test: node bin/dsh-suite.mjs list --json && node -e "import('node:fs').then(({readFileSync})=>{const a=JSON.parse(readFileSync('plugins.json','utf8'));if(!Array.isArray(a)||a.length<47)throw new Error('plugins.json too small');if(!a.every(x=>x.pkg.startsWith('@qingshanjiluo/')))throw new Error('bad pkg name');console.log('smoke ok: '+a.length+' plugins, all scoped')})"

author: qingshanjiluo
